title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced Payroll Administrator with great IT
skills, ideally you will be experienced with using Sage,. This is
a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers,
takes pride in getting the details right, and wants to be part of
a team that values accuracy, This is a 9 month contract which
could go permanent and there is a salary of up £26,000.

.

The Role:

Process end-to-end weekly and monthly payroll, ensuring
accuracy and attention to detail
Ensure payroll is processed efficiently and in line with
statutory obligations and internal procedures.
Carry out manual payroll calculations where required, including
adjustments, deductions and statutory payments.
Respond to payroll queries in a clear, friendly and timely
manner.
Upload pension calculations and submissions for a range of
pension providers.
Build positive working relationships with colleagues,
contributing to a supportive and collaborative team environment.
Assist the wider payroll team with administrative tasks,
deadlines and process improvements where needed.

About You:

A careful and accurate approach, with strong numerical skills
and excellent attention to detail.
A positive team player who is also confident working
independently and taking ownership of their workload.
Friendly and professional communication skills, with the
ability to build trust and rapport with clients and colleagues.
A proactive, organised and dependable approach to work.
Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines and remain calm
during busy payroll periods.
A flexible and supportive attitude, with a willingness to help
others and contribute to the wider team.
A genuine commitment to delivering a high-quality service and
doing the right thing for clients.

Additional Information:

You will be working 9am until 5pm with a 4pm finish on a Friday
Pension
20 days holidays plus bank holidays
Fantastic working environment
A salary of up to £26,000

INDAB

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant
- Location: Wigan
- Salary: £32,000 - £35,000 per annum
- Job Type: Permanent
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm

Benefits
- 28 days holiday including bank holidays
- Company pension scheme
- Free on-site parking
- Ongoing support for professional development and training

Key Responsibilities
- Support the day-to-day operations of the finance department, ensuring financial records are maintained accurately.
- Assist with account reconciliations, financial reporting, and month-end activities.
- Process financial transactions and maintain data within the company's accounting systems.
- Prepare information and analysis for internal stakeholders to support business decision-making.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the business to resolve finance-related queries and improve processes.

Requirements
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar accounting position.
- Strong reconciliation skills and attention to detail.
- Experience supporting month-end processes.
- Good working knowledge of Excel and accounting systems.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- A proactive and flexible approach with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a leading organisation, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
A small manufacturing company based in Wigan, are looking for a bookkeeper to oversee the following duties within the finance team.

Daily and monthly bookkeeping duties:
- Bank reconciliation
- Sales & purchase ledger production.
- Vat return preparation and filing on monthly basis
- Assist the financial controller with the monthly management accounts
- Assist with monthly payroll

Benefits
- Flexible working
- 24 days annual leave + bank holidays
- Pension and life assurance
- Career development opportunities

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Part-time Accounts Assistant
description:
RG Consultancy are currently supporting one of our excellent clients in the search for an Accounts Assistant on a part time, permanent basis. The role will be based in Leigh and offers flexibility depending on the hours you are looking for.

The candidate will perform the following duties:
- Responsible for purchase ledger and sales ledger duties
- Processing invoices
- Processing employee expenses
- Petty cash management
- Dealing with supplier queries over email and managing the accounts payable expenses
- Other ad hoc duties to support the Finance Manager as required

Benefits:
- Flexible hours - 26 per week over 5 days
- Free Parking
- 25 days + bank holidays

title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: A medical receptionist is the primary representative of our GP Practice and is responsible for the efficient administration of all related processes in order to support the work of the clinical team. Your role will be based across the two sites of Heaton Group Health, namely Heaton Medical Centre and Dalefield Surgery. You may be required to work flexibly between these sites as service needs dictate. The ideal candidate will enjoy the challenge of working in a busy GP practice and will project a positive, friendly image when dealing with patients at the surgery and on the phone. Working pattern Two positions available - for 20 hrs per week hours between 8am - 6.30pm Reception/Admin Duties: General medical reception duties such as greeting patients, booking appointments and dealing with queries Answering phone calls Actioning tasks received from clinical staff Administrative and clerical support to clinical and management team Monitor and respond to emails on the generic practice account Liaise with external parties such as secondary care, community teams and care homes Direct patients to appropriate services Provide general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Dealing with all requests in an efficient and courteous manner. Screening enquiries for the doctors and medical staff Registering new patients at the surgery Explaining the practice procedures to new patients Accurately collecting information and personal details about patients Updating the surgeries computer system with appointments and personal details Receiving urine and blood samples and sending them off to hospital laboratories Chasing up appointments for patients with hospitals or with other healthcare professionals Contacting patients to pass on test results /messages to patients as instructed by medical professionals Arranging prescriptions for patients Maintaining a clean reception and waiting area to show a professional image Writing letters and correspondence on behalf of the surgery and medical staff Covering colleagues during times of annual leave You will be responsible for the general administrative and reception duties within the Practice and work with our established processes, policies and procedures to provide a comprehensive high-quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries. Your regular duties in this role will be dealing with telephone, face to face and electronic enquiries, booking and/or amending patient appointments and home visits, contacting patients to provide information from the clinical team and assisting patients to access our services and those available in the wider community

title: Team Administrator
company: Greater Manchester Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Greater Manchester Mental Health NHS Foundation Trust
description: To support the Bolton Directorate in providing a comprehensive administrative service to the relevant administration teams. The post holder will work within the team where extra admin support is needed, and will report to the relevant Administration Manager. These duties may include (dependant on where the cover is required): You will undertake general administrative office duties including the typing of medical and other correspondence, actioning any requirements identified within the typing. They will answer and manage calls from service uses and their carers / relatives and other health and social care professionals. Typing clinic letters and reports, prepare agenda's, minuting meetings and CPA documentation within the CMHT's. This will also include Reception cover. Undertake audio/clerical duties for the wider team, including minute taking as required, clinical letters, reports, discharge correspondence and clinical activity data inputting. To be the first point of contact for written and telephone enquiries on behalf of your team, using judgement to establish validity and priority of the contact. As required by your team, record activity onto appropriate systems meeting all required deadlines. Ensure all discharge notification and summaries are generated and sent to the GP within agreed timeframes. Ability to prioritise workload. To use initiative and take responsibility for own area of work, as well as working effectively as part of a team, ensuring any areas of concern are raised in a timely and appropriate manner. Maintain the highest standard of confidentiality with regards to information concerning service users/staff at all times. Maintain and update service user records and filing systems, involving the use of the Trust's electronic patient record (EPR) systems. Provide cover across Bolton sites for colleagues during times of sickness and annual leave, ensuring service provision is maintained. To be familiar with and comply with all Trust and departmental policies, procedures, protocols and guidelines. Please see attached job description and person specification Staff benefits Pay Enhancements 30% additional for Evenings (8pm onwards) and Saturdays and 60% additional for Sundays and Bank holidays. 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays rising to 29 after 5 years and 33 days after 10 years Excellent pension Cycle to work scheme Salary sacrifice car scheme Wellbeing programme Blue Light Card Discounts
